config.label: Path to a JSON file mapping destination names to system configs (url, client, authType basic/sso/oauth, credentials)
config.description: Path to a JSON file mapping destination names to system configs (url, client, authType basic/sso/oauth, credentials). Recommended; keep the file mode 0600. See systems.example.json

config.label: Inline JSON map of destinations (same shape as SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE)
config.description: Inline JSON map of destinations (same shape as SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE). Contains credentials — prefer SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE

config.label: Destination name used when a tool call omits `destination` (alternatively mark an entry with "default": true)
config.description: Destination name used when a tool call omits `destination` (alternatively mark an entry with "default": true)

config.label: Default auth type for entries that don't specify one: sso (default), basic, or oauth
config.description: Default auth type for entries that don't specify one: sso (default), basic, or oauth

config.label: When set (1024-65535), serve Streamable HTTP on http://127
config.description: When set (1024-65535), serve Streamable HTTP on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp with bearer-token auth instead of stdio

config.label: Bind address for the HTTP transport (default 127
config.description: Bind address for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1). Set 0.0.0.0 only inside containers that publish the port

config.label: Bearer token for the HTTP transport; auto-generated and written to ~/
config.description: Bearer token for the HTTP transport; auto-generated and written to ~/.abap-adt-mcp/http-token when unset

config.label: Maximum concurrent MCP sessions on the HTTP transport (default 16); further initialize requests get 503
config.description: Maximum concurrent MCP sessions on the HTTP transport (default 16); further initialize requests get 503

config.label: Largest request body the HTTP transport accepts, in bytes (default 4194304); larger bodies are refused with HTTP 413
config.description: Largest request body the HTTP transport accepts, in bytes (default 4194304); larger bodies are refused with HTTP 413

config.label: Idle minutes after which an HTTP session (and its SAP sessions/locks) is closed (default 30)
config.description: Idle minutes after which an HTTP session (and its SAP sessions/locks) is closed (default 30)

config.label: Comma-separated Origin values allowed on the HTTP transport (loopback origins always allowed when bound to loopback; * allows any)
config.description: Comma-separated Origin values allowed on the HTTP transport (loopback origins always allowed when bound to loopback; * allows any)

config.label: Comma-separated Host header values allowed (DNS-rebinding protection; loopback hosts always allowed when bound to loopback)
config.description: Comma-separated Host header values allowed (DNS-rebinding protection; loopback hosts always allowed when bound to loopback)

config.label: When set, exportPackageSources may only write inside this directory
config.description: When set, exportPackageSources may only write inside this directory

config.description: Path of a JSONL audit trail: one record per tool call (tool, destination, duration, outcome ok/error/denied/unavailable, policy gate, redacted argument summary)
